reference_role: Existing title is a mood reference, not an edit target. New notebook image will be a visual-system reference for subsequent boards.
shared: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished raster GUI concept for GGB, a Korean 2D point-and-click psychological gothic-to-SF adventure. This is a concrete game screen design, not a website or an infographic. Readability and immediately apparent actions come first. Established art direction: near-black gothic manor, restrained plum and teal environmental light, pale warm ivory paper reading surfaces, dark graphite text, restrained brass rules, small engraved corners, crisp modern Korean sans-serif body typography. Ornament only at edges. Large quiet text areas, generous margins, clear labeled controls and separate visible keyboard focus. No tiny fake body text, no decorative handwriting for essential information. No combat HUD, currency, XP, relationship hearts, quest checklist wall, or mobile controls. Distinguish read-only notebook from interactive puzzle boards. Character signature colors are small provenance marks only, never primary button colors. Korean text exactly as specified, do not add random English copy or invented game lore. All diagrams are visual composition examples, not canonical puzzle solutions. Flat front-on game UI capture, no monitor/device mockup, no desk props outside the game, no perspective distortion. Keep every frame and footer fully inside the image. Render at high detail, landscape.

boards.title: 통합 수첩 · 읽기
boards.prompt: Create ONE full-screen 16:9 hero screenshot of the unified notebook opened over a dim gothic manor. A wide flat ivory notebook panel occupies 86% of the screen; faint binding seam only, flat aligned text. Top header '수첩', small status '게임 일시정지', right '닫기 Esc'. Four large tabs exactly '단서', '대화', '기록', '인물', with '단서' selected in graphite fill and an underline. Below: search field '자료 검색', secondary '필터', filter chip '최근 단서'. Left 28% is a clean list with selected '시계망 배선 탁본', then '업무 시간표', then '일지 조각'. Small selected-row tag '관찰'. Right 72% is a large readable material detail titled '시계망 배선 탁본', provenance '발견 장소 · 외부 서고'. Most of right page is a beautiful charcoal rubbing of paper, a clearly visible upper notch, four connected simple clock-like nodes, graphite strokes and worn paper edges, not a solved diagram. Under the artifact: '종이의 홈과 선이 이어지는 위치를 살펴보자.' Bottom detail actions '고정하기', primary dark button '비교에 담기', secondary '크게 보기'. A slim bottom tray shows '비교할 자료 1개' with one paper thumbnail and a subdued '자료를 하나 더 담아 주세요'. Bottom left helper '확인한 자료만 표시됩니다'. Show one small square '새 기록' marker without glowing clutter. Paper should be pale ivory, not yellow sepia; dark text must be high contrast. No future locked content, no tab for freeform writing, no puzzle submit button.

boards.title: 자료 비교 · 확대 대응
boards.prompt: Create a presentation board with TWO large game-screen mockups, one above the other, each wide 16:9; overall canvas approximately 16:18, enough resolution for crisp Korean. Small outside captions '자료 비교' and '글자 확대 시'. Upper screenshot is a bright ivory notebook comparison screen over near-black background. Header '자료 비교', subtitle '열람용 · 퍼즐에는 반영되지 않습니다', button '닫기 Esc'. Two equal large reading panes A and B. A title '시계망 배선 탁본', B title '업무 시간표'. A has a large graphite rubbing with a top notch and partial node lines; B has a readable two-row schedule with '대시계 점검' and '내실 복귀', each with independent blank/rule columns; do not invent time-based solution. Each pane has '자료 바꾸기' and '크게 보기'. Bottom tray has three distinct labeled paper thumbnails and '비교 묶음'. Top left '목록으로'. Lower screenshot demonstrates 200% text reflow: a single full-width large paper pane, big A/B tabs 'A 탁본', 'B 시간표', title '시계망 배선 탁본', large central graphite drawing, only one sentence of big readable body text '종이 위쪽에 작은 홈이 있다.', fixed visible footer '자료 바꾸기', '크게 보기', '목록으로'. No tiny side columns in enlarged version. Keep all controls unclipped. Use the same restrained paper/graphite/brass visual language as reference.

boards.title: 탐색 · 대화 · 소지품 · 지도
boards.prompt: Create a 2x2 board of FOUR equally sized wide 16:9 in-game screenshots, thin gutters, overall 16:9 canvas at high detail. Small outside captions 01 탐색, 02 대화, 03 소지품, 04 지도. Same elegant GGB style in all panels. Panel1: atmospheric illustrated gothic archive room, huge unobstructed playfield. Small upper-left goal '시계의 흔적을 조사한다'. Focus outline around an actual desk paper with adjacent text '탁본 살펴보기'. Bottom discrete labeled buttons '소지품 I', '수첩 N', '지도', '메뉴 Esc'. Upper-right quiet toast '새 단서 · 수첩에 기록됨'. Panel2: same room dimmed, bottom quarter occupied by high-contrast charcoal dialogue panel. Speaker block '관찰' separate from text '종이 위쪽에 작은 홈이 있다.' Footer '대화 기록 H', '다음 Enter', '메뉴 Esc'. Small adjacent separate specimen of thought caption '생각' with text '어디에 맞춰 놓았던 걸까?' No character portrait needed, no random character design. Panel3: pale ivory inventory drawer in lower half with exactly three illustrated items: '작은 열쇠', '마른 천', '종이 조각'. Selected small key is outlined; readable detail '작은 열쇠', '현재 하루', primary '사용하기', secondary '살펴보기', '닫기'. Show explicit status '사용할 대상을 선택하세요' in a clear bar. Panel4: pale paper discovered-room map over darkness, readable rooms '침실', '중앙홀', '외부 서고', '기록 내실'; black dot and '현재 위치', lock icon with '잠김', folded-path marker '지름길'. No undiscovered rooms, no teleport button, no full-map completion percentage. Simple coherent plan, not a huge maze.

boards.title: 퍼즐 · 복원 · 힌트 · 실패 복구
boards.prompt: Create a high-detail 2x2 board of FOUR 16:9 game screenshots, overall 16:9, thin gutters, small external captions. Panel1 '시계망': ivory and graphite interactive puzzle workbench, header '시계망', clear purpose '탁본의 선이 이어지도록 놓아 보자'. Left two small source thumbnails labeled '확보한 자료'; center four large physical paper tiles with clear upper-edge notches and connected line fragments; right compact '검증 상태' with '아직 확인하지 않음'. Bottom visible buttons '회전', '자리 바꾸기', '약한 진동으로 확인', '수첩', '나가기'. This is input stage, do not present a solved puzzle. Panel2 '일지 복원': large ivory work area with three wide torn paper fragments, visible graphite pressure lines crossing edges and alignment guides, small readable fragment labels '조각 1', '조각 2', '조각 3'. Header '일지 복원'; footer '앞뒤 보기', '되돌리기', '이어짐 확인', '수첩'. Prominent physical evidence rather than paragraphs. Panel3 '생각을 정리한다': readable large hint panel '어느 정도 도움을 받을까요?' with five sequential rows '관찰', '연결', '변환', '부분 검증', '직접 지원'. Only first row expanded, '놓친 흔적부터 살펴봅니다.' Bottom '이 도움 보기', '돌아가기'. No automatic spoilers. Panel4 '다시 시도하기': calm feedback panel with heading '일부 연결을 다시 살펴보자'. Two clear sections '유지되는 정보' and '다시 준비할 것', each one short neutral line '확인한 자료와 관찰' and '이번 하루의 장치 상태'. Footer '자료 확인', '돌아가기'. Small separate inset irreversible action confirmation: '실행하면 이번 하루에는 되돌릴 수 없습니다', equal '취소' and '실행'. No red full-screen failure overlay, no numerical lives, no hidden solution revealed.

boards.title: 타이틀 · 저장 · 일시정지 · 복구
boards.prompt: Create a high-detail 2x2 board of FOUR equally sized 16:9 game screenshots with thin gutters, overall 16:9. Match existing gothic title mood but improve legibility: near-black manor, subtle purple/teal light only in environment, quiet warm ivory type and brass outlines. Panel1 title screen: GGB logo at left, clear menu at right '계속하기', '새 게임', '불러오기', '설정', '종료', small bottom links '콘텐츠 안내', '크레딧', '감상 기록'. Primary continue has visible double focus border; no slogan. Panel2 save slots: pale ivory modal titled '불러오기', EXACTLY THREE large rows. '슬롯 1 · 외부 서고', '슬롯 2 · 침실', '슬롯 3 · 빈 슬롯'. First has short '마지막 저장' and '플레이 시간' metadata without invented date. Footer '불러오기', '데모 저장 가져오기', '돌아가기'. Panel3 pause: a calm opaque charcoal menu over darkened room headed '일시정지'. '계속', '수첩', '대화 기록', '불러오기', '설정', '저장하고 타이틀로'. A clearly separate small status line '마지막 안전 지점에서 이어집니다'. Panel4 recovery: warm ivory dialog '저장 파일을 확인해 주세요', text '이전 정상 저장에서 복구할 수 있습니다.' Two preview rows '현재 저장 · 읽을 수 없음' and '이전 정상 저장 · 복구 가능'. Clear actions '백업에서 복구', '취소'. No developer codes or JSON. Small bottom status strip with standalone state examples '저장 중' and '저장 완료', separated by a divider, not shown simultaneously as a live save.

boards.title: 첫 실행 · 설정 · 입력 · 화면 확인
boards.prompt: Create a high-detail 2x2 board of FOUR wide 16:9 game UI mockups, overall 16:9, restrained warm ivory reading panels and dark gothic margins. Each screenshot must be readable, spacious, with very few well-chosen controls. Panel1 first-run accessibility: heading '편하게 읽고 플레이하세요'. Rows '언어 한국어', '글자 크기 125%', '감각 자막 켜기', '움직임 줄이기'. Big live sample sentence '종이 위쪽에 작은 홈이 있다.' Bottom '이 설정으로 시작', '기본값으로 시작'. Panel2 settings: left tabs '접근성', '화면', '소리', '조작', '언어'. Accessibility selected. Right title '접근성'; rows '글자 크기', 'UI 크기', '색상 서명', '흔들림', '섬광'. Five sample signature chips distinguished by vertical line, diagonal brush, double pulse, radiating petals, double frame, with Korean names '에드가', '마라 1', '루카', '이리스', '마라 2'. Use clear labels and patterns, colors secondary. Footer '적용', '돌아가기'. Panel3 key binding: title '조작 설정', rows '확인 Enter', '수첩 N', '소지품 I', '대화 기록 H', '취소 Esc'; small readable conflict card '이미 사용 중인 키입니다', '서로 바꾸기', '취소'. Panel4 display confirmation: heading '이 화면 설정을 유지할까요?', big '15초 후 이전 설정으로 돌아갑니다', two equal buttons '유지', '되돌리기'; dim settings behind. Do not use accessibility score or claim compliance. All text should be sharply typeset, no faux manuscript body font.

boards.title: 파열 이후 · 최종 선택 · 감상 기록 · 데모
boards.prompt: Create a high-detail 2x2 board of FOUR wide 16:9 GGB game screens, overall 16:9 canvas, small external captions. Keep the same navigation and pale paper notebook identity even after gothic world exposes a restrained cold graphite machine structure. No cyberpunk neon dashboard. Panel1 late-game material record: heading '기록 대조', pale ivory reading card on a dark exposed archive wall, five small source chips with distinct line patterns and names '에드가', '마라 1', '루카', '이리스', '마라 2'. Big two-column evidence panes '원본 기록' and '확인한 내용', a few clean lines, controls '수첩', '출처 보기', '돌아가기'. No affection scores. Panel2 FINAL CHOICE: perfectly symmetric screen with two identical same-color neutral ivory cards, same size and brightness, same amount of text, same buttons. Left title '기상 절차 실행', right title '안정화 루프 복원'. BOTH contain identical subheadings '확실한 정보', '불확실한 정보', and button '절차 살펴보기'. Center below between them is a small notebook pedestal and focus ring labeled '수첩 확인'; neither ending card is selected or highlighted. No good/bad imagery, no green/red or warm/cold pairing. Panel3 gallery: heading '감상 기록', one unlocked paper card '마지막 장면', sublabel '확인한 기록 다시 읽기', a static quiet manor thumbnail, buttons '기록 열기', '크레딧', '타이틀로'. No locked future endings or unknown-count placeholders, no video play icon. Panel4 demo end: elegant dark background, heading '데모를 마쳤습니다', short text '이곳까지의 기록이 저장되었습니다.', visible '감상 기록', '타이틀로', and smaller explanatory line '본편에서 데모 저장을 가져올 수 있습니다'. Show four related experiences, no new game lore.
